title: Plan review: retry webhook deliveries with backoff

defects.title: The plan hand-writes a retry loop although withRetry in src/lib/retry.ts already does this
defects.catch_criteria: The review must identify that the attempt loop planned in phase-1/t1 (deliverWithRetry's `for` loop with a rethrow on a non-retryable error or the last try and `sleep(500 * 2 ** attempt)` between tries) re-implements withRetry in src/lib/retry.ts, which already takes attempts, baseDelayMs with doubling backoff, an isRetryable predicate, and an injectable sleep, and which sendMail in src/email/sender.ts already uses the same way; deliverWithRetry should be withRetry(() => deliverWebhook(...), { attempts: 5, baseDelayMs: 500, isRetryable: isRetryableWebhookError }) so the project keeps one retry policy implementation. Any wording and any severity count, as long as the hand-written loop and the existing withRetry are both named, with the phase-1/t1 location. Noting that the hand-written loop also drops withRetry's jitter counts as part of the same finding.

review_prompt_hint: This is an implementation plan (plan-handoff JSON) that retries failed webhook deliveries with backoff, per endpoint. Check every structural choice the plan makes against the code
